text:
Emma (CS): heads-up: we're seeing an embeddings sync stall affecting EU onboarding tenants. Not full outage but delayed ingestion and some 5xxs on batch jobs :warning:
Prashant (SRE): investigating now. Looks like a region failover race on the reindex lambda, working hypothesis: stale KV lock during rolling deploy :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Emma (CS): ok — who can sanity-check list of impacted tenants? I'll start drafting comms for onboarding and renewal-risk buckets
Jordan (AE): I can pull the high-touch list — sending CSV to thread in a sec
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-03-EU-EMB created by Prashant (SRE) — severity: medium — ETA initial update 15m
Prashant (SRE): repro steps: ran backfill -> multiple workers attempted prefix-lock -> lock contention -> backoff retries hitting 503s. Mitigation applied: disabled parallel backfill and reinstated single-writer mode. Monitoring now reported reduced error rate
Zoe (Product): thanks. Can we get a short customer-facing explanation and two remediation options (auto-retry vs manual reindex) so CS can advise? Also capture any quality regressions for customers who saw partial indexes
Emma (CS): drafting comm — keeping it clear and non-technical. Proposed template snippet:

```
Hi [Customer],

We're reaching out because you may have experienced delays with onboarding search/embedding indexing in our EU region between 2026-03-18 02:10 UTC and 2026-03-18 02:40 UTC. We applied a mitigation and reindexing is in progress.

What we did: temporarily disabled parallel reindexing to stop retries causing 503s and resumed a single-writer backfill.

What you may see: slightly delayed search results or missing embedding hits until reindex completes.

What we recommend: no immediate action is required; we will finish reindex and follow up when complete. If you prefer us to run an expedited manual reindex for your tenant, reply to this thread and we'll queue it.

We're offering a one-time service credit for tenants impacted during their onboarding window; details below.

Regards,
Redwood Customer Success
```

Emma (CS): tag @Jordan for any account-specific wording for renewal-sensitive customers :thumbsup:
Jordan (AE): noted — for four accounts in renewal next 30 days I suggest calling them directly and offering a 20% credit + joint troubleshooting session. I'll do the outreach after Emma's draft
Prashant (SRE): inc update: error rate dropped from 6% -> 0.4% after mitigation. Continuing observation for 30m. No data loss expected; reindex backlog estimated 45-90 minutes depending on tenant size
Emma (CS): action items: 1) send customer comm to impacted onboarding list (I will) 2) offer expedited manual reindex for high-touch 3) flag renewal accounts for AE outreach 4) collect feedback via short form and invite affected customers to office hours
Zoe (Product): add QA step: check embedding similarity drift on a small sample before marking reindex complete
Emma (CS): feedback capture form (short): https://forms.redwood.ai/embeds-incident-feedback — please paste into outbound comms. Also scheduling office hours: today 16:00 UTC — invite link: https://meet.redwood.ai/officehours
Prashant (SRE): ops note for CS: if customers ask for rollback timeframe, say: mitigation halted concurrent backfills; full reindex completion depends on tenant size, median 60m; we'll notify when individual tenant reindex finished
Jordan (AE): I will compile the renewal-touch list and DM Emma. Also confirming the credit wording: "one-time service credit proportional to onboarding time lost, details in invoice adjustments" — ok?
Emma (CS): yes, that wording works. I'll include a short FAQ in the comm for the 3 most common questions
OpsBot: INC-2026-03-EU-EMB status update — mitigated, monitoring — next update scheduled at 1799912400
Emma (CS): thanks everyone. After we send comm, i'll post a follow-up thread with exact tenant list + timestamps of completion for each tenant. Keep reactions for approvals :white_check_mark:
